bench.does: Five advisory seats each give Chief one opinion on a decision question.
bench.fires: Chief says "convene the bench" or "bench this".
bench.gives: A side-by-side table of five opinions plus one line on where they agree.
bench.steps: write question → five seats answer alone → table → one-line split
bench.weak: Five agents per question cost a lot, and seats never see each other, so none sharpens another.

brainstorm.does: Claude riffs on an idea with Chief, one question at a time, then writes a short design brief.
brainstorm.fires: Chief says "brainstorm X", "riff on X", "interview me" or "refine X".
brainstorm.gives: A short brief: goal, what is in and out, decisions, open calls.
brainstorm.steps: check what is known → one question → options with a rec → play back → "lock it" → brief
brainstorm.weak: Many one-question turns are slow when Chief already knows what he wants.

collect.does: Turns a file full of links into one finished register of what each link says.
collect.fires: Chief says "collect the locus", "pull every link in …" or "run the locus".
collect.gives: Fetched link texts, batch notes and one register file, with every link proven covered.
collect.steps: script fetches links → haiku agents extract → one sonnet writes register → script checks coverage
collect.weak: Links behind bot walls die, and over 36 links the run stops to wait for Chief's call.

config-gc.does: Audits the repo's config for dead weight and asks Chief about each deletion.
config-gc.fires: Only when Chief says "config GC" or "clean the config".
config-gc.gives: A numbered candidate list, soft-deleted items, and a log line for each action.
config-gc.steps: ask channels → read-only scan → rank 20 candidates → ask one by one → log moves
config-gc.weak: One question per item makes a long session, and age alone can flag seasonal skills.

context-budget.does: Tells Chief where the context is going, without scanning his machine.
context-budget.fires: Chief says "context budget" or "what's eating the context".
context-budget.gives: A pointer to /context, or a byte-size table of always-loaded files.
context-budget.steps: point to /context → if asked, measure always-loaded files → list top three → suggest trims
context-budget.weak: It only estimates static load, so the real number still needs Chief to type /context.

dope-sheet.does: Builds the standing status page for one watchlist item (BOLO N).
dope-sheet.fires: Chief says "DOPE SHEET N", "the dope on N" or "build the sheet for N".
dope-sheet.gives: A published status page with situation, execution, admin, log, order and calls.
dope-sheet.steps: script gathers mentions → one sonnet drafts → main line writes order and calls → script checks → publish
dope-sheet.weak: The main line still hand-edits the draft JSON, and an existing sheet needs frago instead.

frago.does: Pushes a small update onto an existing DOPE SHEET without rewriting it.
frago.fires: Chief says "FRAGO N", "update the sheet for N" or "push that onto N".
frago.gives: A new sheet version, a log entry, and a republish to the same URL.
frago.steps: write small patch → script merges and bumps version → build → publish to standing URL
frago.weak: A missing glossary key fails the build, and the patch must match existing items by exact prefix.

intake.does: Scans GitHub repos for ideas worth adding to the Command, and lets Chief keep or skip each.
intake.fires: Chief says "intake" with GitHub links, or "run the intake on these repos".
intake.gives: A picks file per repo and a picker page where Chief keeps or skips each pick.
intake.steps: script scans repo → license gate → one sonnet per repo judges → picker page → Chief picks
intake.weak: Repos with no license stop the run, and Node installers must be hand-copied, which is slow.

launch.does: Starts the local stations, opens both boards, then runs the sit rep with a status poll.
launch.fires: Chief says "go for launch" or "launch sequence".
launch.gives: Running stations, two open boards, an audit result, and a sit rep reply with the poll.
launch.steps: audit runs first → script starts down stations → boards open → sit rep runs → poll above the board
launch.weak: It must run from Bash, not PowerShell, or JUDY's paste breaks; a failed audit adds a NO-GO line.

oscar-mike.does: Closes out the session: stops stations, saves a note, updates the journal and STATE.
oscar-mike.fires: Chief says "Oscar Mike" or "we're Oscar Mike".
oscar-mike.gives: A session note in _CACHE, a journal line, a STATE bullet and the OUT block.
oscar-mike.steps: stations shut down → script pulls transcript → haiku drafts note → main line rules it → OUT block
oscar-mike.weak: Parallel sessions confuse it unless the session id is passed, and the main line still edits by hand.

rtb.does: Clears the old parked cards by promoting, deleting or keeping each one.
rtb.fires: Chief says "RTB", "clear the cards" or "send the cards home".
rtb.gives: A table of rulings, cards moved or deleted, and an updated INDEX.
rtb.steps: script compiles cards → haiku proposes one fate each → main line rules → execute and update INDEX
rtb.weak: It retires itself once the oscar-mike folder is empty, and cards holding Chief's decisions still wait.

safety-guard.does: Freezes named scripts and processes so nothing edits or kills a running detached job.
safety-guard.fires: Chief says "freeze" or "safety guard"; "unfreeze" lifts it.
safety-guard.gives: A written frozen list that the session keeps until Chief lifts it.
safety-guard.steps: Chief names running scripts → Claude writes frozen list → edits and kills blocked → unfreeze lifts it
safety-guard.weak: It is only Claude's promise with no hook to enforce it, so a compact could drop it.

sitrep.does: Delivers the sit rep: a status board of what is active, blocked and done.
sitrep.fires: Chief says "sit rep", "the board", "where did we leave off" or the countersign.
sitrep.gives: A published SITREP dashboard page and a short reply with the blocks.
sitrep.steps: script preps → three agents write blocks → RANGE script reviews → main line writes Block VI → publish
sitrep.weak: Heavy: three agents, a review script and a publish, and the first one each session needs an extra page read.

steel-man.does: Gives the strongest honest case for the other side of a rec or decision.
steel-man.fires: Chief says "steel-man X" or "strongest case for X".
steel-man.gives: A spoken case under 150 words, with no verdict.
steel-man.steps: name target and alternative → write best honest case → stop at 150 words

strategic-compact.does: Judges whether now is a good moment for Chief to run /compact.
strategic-compact.fires: Chief says "compact check" or "should we compact".
strategic-compact.gives: A one-line verdict, one line of why, and the command to type.
strategic-compact.steps: name the phase → look up the table → save unsaved state to a file → give the command
strategic-compact.weak: Claude cannot press /compact itself, and it judges by task phase, not a live token number.

autocommit.sh.does: Saves the repo with a local git commit after every Claude turn.
autocommit.sh.fires: Stop hook: runs when Claude finishes a turn, on /clear, resume and compact.
autocommit.sh.gives: A local autosave commit named with time, file count and top folders.
autocommit.sh.steps: check repo and changes → count files → add all → commit locally → print a short message
autocommit.sh.weak: It never pushes, so unpushed commits pile up, and it commits everything, even noisy log files.

digest.py.does: Prints a short digest of the Command's state so the session opens without reading big files.
digest.py.fires: SessionStart hook: runs every time a session opens.
digest.py.gives: About 40 lines of digest in context, built with zero tokens.
digest.py.steps: hook starts script → reads STATE, BOLO and others → checks local ports → prints digest
digest.py.weak: It reads the large files itself every session, and its private-block filter needs exact tags.

no_probe.py.does: Blocks shell commands that scan Chief's machine or delete protected folders, unless he named the box.
no_probe.py.fires: PreToolUse hook: runs before every Bash or PowerShell call.
no_probe.py.gives: A block message to Claude, or silence when the command is allowed.
no_probe.py.steps: read command → split into segments → check scan and delete patterns → allow, or exit 2 to block
no_probe.py.weak: Pattern matching can miss odd commands or block safe ones, and the 60-minute marker is set by hand.

order_hint.py.does: Spots a garbled proword in Chief's message and prints one hint line for Claude.
order_hint.py.fires: UserPromptSubmit hook: runs each time Chief sends a prompt.
order_hint.py.gives: One line "ORDER HINT · proword (matched text, score)" when the match scores 0.9 or higher.
order_hint.py.steps: clean tags and paths → skip long dumps → fuzzy-match prowords → print the best hit
order_hint.py.weak: It misfired once on editor tags, and it ignores prompts over 400 characters.

precompact_backup.py.does: Copies the transcript to a backup before the context is compacted.
precompact_backup.py.fires: PreCompact hook: runs right before every compact.
precompact_backup.py.gives: A transcript copy in _LOG/transcripts and a note line in the newest session note.
precompact_backup.py.steps: read hook input → copy transcript to _LOG → append a note line to newest _CACHE note
precompact_backup.py.weak: It swallows every error silently, so a failed backup would show nothing.

workflow:sitrep.does: Runs the sit rep as a scripted Workflow, an alternative to the sitrep skill.
workflow:sitrep.fires: No proword; it is an untested alternative that must be launched on purpose.
workflow:sitrep.gives: Prepared fragments and an assembled sit rep, stopping before Block VI, build and publish.
workflow:sitrep.steps: script preps → rack, index and watch agents write → assemble script reviews → rerun named roles
workflow:sitrep.weak: It overlaps the sitrep skill, is untested, and its agents must fetch their own briefs.
